title: Linh Sơn Temple

buildingCutout.basis: The exact named main roofing outline defines the headhouse replacement footprint.

terrainReference.basis: Independent ground at the foot of the mapped public forecourt approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap building and the adjoining footpath, with tower position estimated from the local photographs.
mapIdentity.scope: The exact mapped sanctuary footprint and adjoining footpath establish the main hall fronts. The nearby tower and approach walls use estimated outlines located from the 2011 photographs.

note: The local public-domain series documents leaf-red roof tiles, pale eaves and dragon ridges, deep red veranda columns, the ornate ridge crest, and the octagonal white tower with a peaked dark canopy.
